summary: YPF S.A. disclosed in a 6-K filing (Argentine relevant information report) that it repurchased Class XXVII Notes (YMCTO) between September 15 and September 18, 2026, for Ps. 35,212,692,686.15, equal to US$23,368,197 par value, at an average price of 99.77% of nominal value. The notes were issued in October 2023 at US$127,904,997 par and mature October 2026; repurchased notes will be held in treasury. No board recommendation or advisor was named. Watch for further buybacks or refinancing signals as the October 2026 maturity approaches.
